title: ARV idea comes from Lazar, Sorensen and McKinnish

tellings.quote: a lot of that fell into the psyche of of the UFO Community because of Bob Lazar and then Brad Sensen and Mark Mark mcis

plain: The idea of the ARV, short for alien reproduction vehicle, a supposed human-built copy of an alien craft, took hold in the UFO community because of three men: Bob Lazar, Brad Sorensen and Mark McCandlish. The researcher Eric W. Davis says this on Michels's show without naming a source, tracing where the notion came from rather than vouching for it.
